name: Image Difference Comparator

seo.title: Image Difference Comparator — Browser-Local Tool
seo.meta_description: Compare two same-size images pixel by pixel and export a visual diff plus quantitative mismatch metrics.

assumptions: Images must be the same dimensions unless the user explicitly chooses normalization.
limitations: Pixel differences are sensitive to colour management, antialiasing and lossy compression and are not equivalent to perceptual similarity.
